requirement.statement: web-server SHALL provide POST /api/execute-kon for Kon scripts: requests contain {source: string, scope?: object}; successful responses contain {status:"ok", data?: QueryResultData, result?: unknown}, with table-shaped values normalized as data and other final values returned as result; failures contain {status:"error", error: string}. Each request SHALL execute independently against the configured demo data sources. The legacy POST /api/execute FlowCell product endpoint SHALL NOT be provided.

case.given: the server has initialized its demo data
case.when: POST /api/execute-kon executes a Kon spl_connect plus spl_query script
case.then: the response SHALL be status=ok with the expected data.columns and data.rows

case.given: source references an unknown data source or has invalid syntax
case.then: the response SHALL be {status:"error", error} with actionable detail

case.when: the web server receives the request
case.then: the server SHALL NOT expose a legacy FlowCell product endpoint

requirement.statement: web-ide SHALL expose a Kon script editor at the default route / with a script text editor, demo selector and loader, Run Script action, status area, and result table. It SHALL POST to /api/execute-kon, render response data as columns and rows, and show an Error: prefixed readable message when execution fails. The product SHALL NOT expose the legacy FlowCell grid route.

case.given: the editor contains a valid Kon query script against demo data
case.then: status SHALL become Done and the result table SHALL show non-empty rows

case.given: the script references an unknown data source
case.then: the status SHALL show Error: with actionable detail
the application SHALL NOT expose the legacy grid IDE

requirement.statement: web-ide SHALL provide a Kon-only Playwright E2E suite covering demo loading, query/file/multi-source execution, flow-control assertions, and error handling. The retired grid E2E suite SHALL NOT remain in the product test surface.

case.then: all Kon E2E cases SHALL pass

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL expose the web product surface as Kon script execution only, with legacy FlowCell grid routes, demos, and endpoint contracts removed from the product-facing web packages.

case.given: 用户打开 web-ide 默认路由
case.then: 系统 SHALL show the Kon script editor and Kon demo list
case.and: 系统 SHALL NOT expose a /grid-legacy route

case.given: 前端提交 Kon 脚本
case.then: 系统 SHALL call POST /api/execute-kon and render returned table data

case.given: 调用方请求旧 POST /api/execute endpoint
case.then: 系统 SHALL NOT provide the legacy FlowCell endpoint as a product API
系统 SHALL preserve spl-flow / FlowCell engine behavior
